\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
% Region-coordinate contract fixture: the visible page box is not the MediaBox.
%
% The page size is pinned to US Letter (8.5in x 11in = 612 x 792 PDF points),
% so the MediaBox is [0 0 612 792] on every TeX installation regardless of the
% system default paper size. This sets a CropBox whose lower-left corner is
% (36, 54) -- deliberately not (0, 0) -- so the visible page box (CropBox
% intersected with MediaBox) is [36 54 576 756], i.e. 540 x 702 points. Region
% coordinates must be measured from the top-left of that visible box;
% measuring from the MediaBox instead shifts every crop and drops the sentinel
% line below.
\pdfpagewidth=8.5in
\pdfpageheight=11in
\pdfpageattr{/CropBox [36 54 576 756]}
\begin{document}

\noindent The cropboxsentinel-tango marker sits on the first line of this page.

\end{document}
